title: Tokenized deposits — interactive explainer
learning_objective: Show how the token's legal meaning, authoritative ledger and settlement design change who owes the money and how transfers work.
audience: Mixed executive, banking, legal and technical audience

data.source: Project research notes; no live data

assumptions: CHF amounts are illustrative and not market data.
Cross-border examples use a fixed illustrative 1 CHF = 1 EUR rate.
Legal, accounting and finality outcomes are model-dependent and require product-specific review.
